title: Test case 6 — Murder of a paramedic on duty (life imprisonment; the 30-year standard sentence)
shows: A life maximum and the standard sentence variant the form asks about: the victim was an emergency worker on duty (proved at trial), so the standard sentence for murder is 30 years instead of 25. Life imprisonment can be proposed and checked: under the scheme its non-parole period must be at least 30 years unless that is not in the interests of justice. The offender's prior convictions also bring up the offender-status schemes, which the app does not check (it says so).
